theme: Green Belt, grey belt and Golden Rules

sources.title: Green Belt
sources.facts: Current guidance explains Green Belt reviews and identifying grey belt land for plan-making and decision-making.
sources.guard: Green Belt guidance, policy chapters, glossary definitions, viability rules and consultations do not by themselves prove that a parcel is grey belt, that release is justified, that development is appropriate, or that planning permission and contributions are secured.
